title: Decoding a mapped buffer tape
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a type with decidable equality, let $e$ be an injective map from the Boolean alphabet into $\Gamma$, let $w$ be a Boolean word, and let $p$ be an integer cell. Reading the buffer tape for the word obtained by applying $e$ to each symbol of $w$ at cell $p$, then decoding its symbol through $e$, gives exactly the optional symbol on the buffer tape for $w$ at $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $\Gamma$ is a type with decidable equality
$e$ is an embedding of the Boolean alphabet into $\Gamma$
